why: responses-v2 plus the pilot's double-duty rule (2026-09-11): a Dragon earns a slot only if it is also a spell the list would play. Marang River Regent carries Return of the Wildspeaker's draw-three a mana cheaper or bounces two permanents on a body; Steel Hellkite is repeatable removal by mana value on a 5/5, replacing the single-job anthem the doctor ranked first to cut. The goldfish sees the bodies and the draw, not the answers, so the objective is a CONTROL on the clock (v2 read 0.776).
